Message:
ALSA: hda/relatek: Enable Mute LED on HP Laptop 15s-fq2xxx

This HP Laptop uses ALC236 codec with COEF 0x07 idx 1 controlling
the mute LED. This patch enables the already existing quirk for
this device.
